method: git subtree add (no squash) on the pull request branch; the repository merges squash-only, so .github/workflows/ensemble-catchup.yml links the source history to main afterwards (git merge -s ours, no file changes)
catch_up: dispatch .github/workflows/ensemble-catchup.yml (qnfo-research-exec does it while the history is unlinked or the legacy repository has newer cycles); by hand: git fetch https://github.com/QNFO/qnfo-ensemble-research main && bash tools/ensemble_catchup.sh "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" (links source_head with git merge -s ours, then merges the newer cycles under runs/; a legacy root file that conflicts loses to this repository's own)
